card.name: Bayesian linear regression passage wording
card.fires_on: Words inside a Wikipedia-style passage on Bayesian linear regression and model comparison, such as 'compare', 'competing linear models' and 'prior distribution is assumed'. A weaker second case is a few words in an economics paper listing page.

modes.label: Bayesian regression text
modes.description: Words in sentences about comparing linear models or assuming a prior distribution.
modes.example: The model evidence of the Bayesian linear regression model presented in this section can be used to<< compare>> competing linear models by Bayesian model comparison.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of regression-line words like slope, intercept and plotted, with little else clear.
card.plain: It fires on wording in a statistics passage about Bayesian linear regression, and it makes the model less likely to continue with slope-related words.
